Use-case & requirements summary:
- Workload: customer support chat + automated order lookup (tool-calling).
- UX: streaming responses to minimize latency; client-side parser expects single valid JSON object for function_call arguments once function invocation finishes.
- Targets: p95 latency < 250ms for single-turn order lookup; low token cost (sensitive).
- Model preferences: open to mid-size open models; want deterministic JSON outputs; fallback to smaller model when overloaded.
- Routing/fallback: want simple policy first (region-na, lowest cost compatible model).
- Security: SOC2 baseline required; SSO later. No VPC or on-prem for now.

Troubleshooting notes (observed issues):
- Primary problem: partial/malformed JSON received by client when consuming streaming chunks. Parser fails because argument object is split across chunks (e.g. "\{\"order_id\": 123" then next chunk "45, \"status\": \"open\"}" -> client treats 12345 incorrectly).
- Function schema mismatches: their schema defines order_id as integer, but backend expects string; SDK/node autofill casts; Redwood SDK example uses "string" in examples -> discrepancy.
- Function name mismatch: model sometimes emits 'call_order_lookup' vs expected 'order_lookup' (probable model-side aliasing or human instruction variances).
- Streaming markers: they were relying on a final 'data: [DONE]' to trigger parse; some intermediate chunks include trailing text or diagnostic metadata.
- SDK/Curl differences: curl + stream=true returns newline-delimited events; Node SDK helper buffers differently. Their current parser assumes each function_call block arrives as one event.

What we recommended / actions taken:
- Ask for minimal reproducible example: share curl command using ?stream=true and raw headers.
- Suggested two mitigations: (1) buffer stream on client until function_call finished (watch for role:function_call end signal), (2) instruct model to emit arguments as a single compact JSON string property and then parse on server.
- Created INF-4821 to track server-side formatting investigation. SDK-1192 added example repo showing robust streaming parser.
- Provided Drive doc with recommended function schemas and JSON Mode examples (link above).
